course_deviations: Typed scalar payloads and descriptors, not learned cell embeddings
Timestamp is UTC epoch days, not globally normalized training seconds
Text is preserved UTF-8, not MiniLMv2
Category vocabulary is local and train-only; no cross-database category identity
Missing values retained as explicit MISSING; RT context excludes non-observed feature cells
Untimed tables admit no fit rows; numerical default 0/1 and empty categories
No task labels, attention, objective, model training or performance benchmark
